resources.string: Reach a display over the museum\'s network: see what it shows, and send it a display update made in the staff portal. This phone changes nothing else.

On the display, open the admin panel, then Staff connection, and Open a staff connection. Type the address and the code it shows. This phone must be on the museum\'s network, or on the display\'s own Wi-Fi.
Opened on the display\'s own Wi-Fi? Join that Wi-Fi on this phone first, with the name and password the display shows, then choose On the display\'s own Wi-Fi and type only the code.
Connecting… working out the key from the code takes a moment.
Put a display update on it

Choose a display update (a .cihof file) made with Make a display update in the staff portal and saved to this phone, or to a drive it can reach. The display checks it, and says what it would change, before anything is applied.
Sending %1$s to the display… keep this app open until it is done.
Apply it anyway, replacing what changed on the display since.
Show it now? Only if nobody is using the display: whoever is will be taken back to the start.
✓ Applied. The display is showing it now. Go and look at it.
✓ Applied. The display takes it over at its next reset between visitors.
